feedback.details: Line 66 of skills.ts includes 'documenter' in the agents array. parseSkillYaml correctly handles documenter with inject, reference, and exclude tiers. Tests in sprint3.test.ts (lines 51-107) verify all cases including shorthand exclude and missing-agent-defaults-to-exclude. 4 passing tests.

Line 156 of skills.ts defaults agentList to include 'documenter'. parseLocalSkill correctly routes to documenter when agents frontmatter includes it, and excludes when it doesn't. Tests at lines 109-160 verify agents: [documenter, generator], agents: [planner] (excludes documenter), and reference tier for documenter. 4 passing tests.

Line 352 of skills.ts iterates allAgents including 'documenter' when loading inject-tier content. resolveExternalSkill at line 213 also iterates all four agents. Tests at lines 162-221 verify inject content is loaded for documenter-targeted skills from both local and external skill.yaml sources. 2 passing tests.

routeSkillsForAgent correctly returns empty injected/referenceManifest/additionalDirs when documenter has exclude tier. Lines 138-143 of skills.ts fill missing agents as exclude. Tests at lines 223-295 verify both explicit exclude and no-skills cases. Also verified that missing documenter entry in skill.yaml defaults to exclude (line 82-91).

routeSkillsForAgent at line 386-389 correctly builds reference manifest and additionalDirs for documenter reference tier skills, without injecting content. Tests at lines 269-287 verify referenceManifest contains the file path, additionalDirs has the parent directory, and injected is empty.

Line 84 of types.ts: `docsGenerated?: boolean` is present on HarnessProgress. Tests at lines 301-352 verify it can be set to true/false/undefined, and survives JSON round-trip serialization. 4 passing tests.

Lines 238-278 of harness.ts: when status is 'complete' and !progress.docsGenerated && !config.noDocs, the harness runs only the documenter phase (no sprint loop). After documenter completes, runDocumenterPhase sets docsGenerated=true and writes progress. Tests verify via source code structural analysis (lines 355-365).

Lines 282-283 of harness.ts: when docsGenerated is true, throws Error('All sprints and documentation already completed. Nothing to resume.'). This is caught in index.ts and logged as 'Fatal error:' with exit code 1 (non-zero). The message content matches the criterion, and the Documenter is not re-invoked. Minor concern: exits non-zero rather than cleanly logging and exiting 0, which could be seen as less user-friendly. The test checks the string exists in source.

Lines 288 onward of harness.ts: when status != 'complete', normal resume logic runs (readSpec, sprint loop). Lines 688-706: after sprint loop, if allPassed && !config.noDocs, runDocumenterPhase is called. Tests at lines 383-391 verify both runSprintLoop and runDocumenterPhase calls exist with correct gating conditions.

Lines 798-802 of harness.ts: the catch block in runDocumenterPhase logs a WARNING but does not set docsGenerated=true. The comment explicitly states 'docsGenerated remains false/undefined so resume can re-attempt'. The error is caught so no unhandled exception occurs. Tests verify the comment and warning message exist in source.

doc-validation.ts lines 13-17: checks README.md exists and content.length >= MIN_README_LENGTH (200). If the check passes (>=200 chars), no warning is logged. Test at line 399-406 verifies a 500-char README passes silently without throwing.

doc-validation.ts line 17: logs 'WARNING: Documentation may be incomplete: README.md is very short.' when README exists but < 200 chars. The function never throws, so the run still succeeds. Test at lines 409-421 verifies no throw for short README. Warning message visible in test output.

doc-validation.ts line 19: logs 'WARNING: Documenter did not create README.md.' when README.md doesn't exist. Function never throws. Test at lines 423-429 verifies no throw. Warning 'did not create README.md' visible in test output.

doc-validation.ts lines 24-27: checks CHANGELOG.md existence, logs 'WARNING: Documenter did not create CHANGELOG.md.' if missing. Advisory only — no throw. Tests at lines 432-438 verify no throw for missing CHANGELOG. Warning visible in test output.

validateDocumentation is a void function that never throws. It's called inside the try block of runDocumenterPhase (line 791), and even if it somehow threw, the catch at line 798 would handle it. The harness returns success:true regardless. Tests at lines 441-455 verify the function doesn't throw even with both files missing and returns undefined.

sprint3.test.ts contains 34 test cases covering: skill YAML parsing for documenter (4 tests), local skill routing to documenter (4 tests), resolveSkills for documenter (2 tests), routeSkillsForAgent for documenter (4 tests), docsGenerated field (4 tests), resume compatibility structure (5 tests), validateDocumentation (6 tests), validation integration (3 tests), scanSkillsDir with documenter (2 tests). All 34 pass. Well above the 10 test minimum. bun test passes overall (280 pass, 1 fail unrelated to sprint3 — tracing module dependency issue).

overallSummary: Sprint 3 is well-implemented. All three features (Skills Integration for Documenter, Resume Compatibility, Documentation Quality Validation) are properly coded and tested. The skills system correctly handles 'documenter' as a fourth agent role across all parsing, routing, and resolution functions. Resume logic correctly handles docs-only re-runs, skip-when-done, and normal-sprint-then-docs flows. Documentation validation is advisory-only and checks both README.md and CHANGELOG.md. 34 dedicated sprint3 tests all pass. Minor nit: the 'already completed' resume case throws an error (exit code 1) rather than logging cleanly and exiting 0, which is slightly aggressive but functionally correct.
